How the work runs
Audit
We check the site, the profile and what you already rank for. The findings come to you in writing.
Fix the foundation
Technical issues first. There is no point writing pages a search engine cannot read.
Build the pages
Service, price and area pages, based on what people around you actually search.
Review monthly
Search Console and analytics, read together. What moved, what did not, what is next.
Start with the audit.
How long does SEO take?
Months, not weeks. Technical fixes show up faster. New pages take time to be found and trusted. Anyone promising a ranking in a fortnight is guessing.
Can you guarantee first page rankings?
No, and nobody honestly can. What we can show you is the work. What was fixed, what was written and what was submitted.
Do I need SEO or ads?
Ads bring people now and stop when the budget stops. SEO is slower and keeps working. Most businesses start with ads and build SEO underneath.
Do you do local SEO for Ahmedabad?
Yes, and that is where we start. Google Business Profile, area pages and local details, so people nearby find you first.
Can you do SEO on a site someone else built?
Usually. Send us the link. If the build makes SEO impossible, we will tell you before we quote.
Find out what Google sees
Send us your site. We will tell you what is stopping it from being found, in writing, before you pay us anything.
